race.description: Boxing Day Races @ Ballina Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: SHA FROM THE JAR (1) was heavily supported on debut and ran accordingly with a fast finishing second over 1014m at Coffs Harbour. Nicely drawn again in a weaker race. Go close. MAGIC SNITZEL (8) is a four-start maiden who returned with an encouraging on-pace fourth over 1014m at Coffs Harbour. Has further upside from the right barrier. NAYSTAR (9) is resuming from a lengthy break. Fitted with the two trials and gelded over the break. Keep safe. OSTMEN (3) gelding by Capitalist from Larking on debut. Progressing well with a recent trial win. Market watch. MOONLIT AURA (13) Adam Campton filly making her first race start. Trialled four times in readiness for this with mixed results. Take on trust.
